description: This file defines a React component named MoveTree, which renders a collapsible tree view of analysis moves within a chess analysis session. It visualizes nodes representing moves, their evaluation scores, depth, and allows interaction such as node selection, comment editing, and collapsing/expanding move branches.

methods.name: MoveTree({ session, activeNodeId, onSelectNode, onSetComment, isThinking, })
methods.description: React component for rendering a collapsible move tree analysis view.
